description: This file declares the TransportSecurityPersister class, which manages reading and writing transport security state data to disk, including serialization/deserialization, and handles callbacks for state changes. It is part of the network security infrastructure in Chromium.

classes.name: TransportSecurityPersister
classes.description: Manages persistent storage of transport security state, including serialization, deserialization, and callback handling.

methods.name: TransportSecurityPersister
methods.description: Constructor initializing the persister with state, task runner, and data file path.

methods.name: StateIsDirty
methods.description: Callback invoked when the security state changes, indicating data needs to be persisted.

methods.name: WriteNow
methods.description: Immediately writes the current security state to disk, invoking callback after completion.

methods.name: SerializeData
methods.description: Serializes the current security state into a JSON string, returning an optional string.

methods.name: LoadEntries
methods.description: Loads and applies serialized security state data.
